content.short: Stablecoin payment products, from US to Vietnam business transfers to recurring payments and DCA.
content.description: Papaya builds focused tools for moving money on stablecoin rails. Its cross-border product pays Vietnamese suppliers from US dollars into local bank accounts, its DCA feature lets wallets buy an asset like WETH on a schedule, and the Papaya Protocol adds subscription and recurring stablecoin payments to other apps. The code is on GitHub.
content.meta: Papaya offers US to Vietnam stablecoin payouts, wallet DCA and a protocol for recurring stablecoin payments.
